about: Codex's observed behaviour toward the OA helper, structure and timing only, no values. Sources: the owner's Codex Desktop log (logs_2.sqlite, rmcp and stdio_server_launcher records) and helper-lifecycle.json of 2026-11-01; two codex exec 0.166.0-alpha.5.1 runs against the chaos helper fixture (trace.jsonl). Replayed by TestReplayObservedCodexSession.

retry_burst.note: with errors returned, the model in code mode retried 44 times within 60 ms

client.on_exit: kills the helper; stdin is not closed and no end is recorded

spawns.note: Helpers born for subagent threads (thread_spawn, session_init.mcp_manager_init). They initialize and list tools, never call a tool, and are killed when their thread ends. at_ms is relative to the first; the 128 s gap is compressed to gap_compressed_ms in the replay.

session.note: The working helper of the main thread, started by thread/resume. It made tool calls with the thread for three hours. Modern Standby (Idle Timeout) began at 16:27:11Z; its lease lapsed 56 s and 67 s later in two helpers; the next tool call came 22 minutes later, after wake, and got Transport closed from the old build.
